title: A test requires a real gym to get 12 sample products when the shop is turned on
what: Turning on the shop in a real gym adds 12 made-up products that members can see and order in the app, and a test checks that this happens. The journey says a real gym must never get sample products and should see "No products yet".
expected: A real gym starts with an empty shop, or the journey is changed on purpose; the test should check whichever is agreed.
how_often: every gym that turns on the shop
fix_line: Decide if new gyms get sample products; then fix the screen or the journey and the test to match

title: A test requires the bell History to keep lines older than 7 days
what: The bell History is promised as "the last 7 days", and the journey says no line older than 7 days may be in it. The bell test checks the opposite: a week later, an unopened line sits in History tagged "Older than 7 days".
expected: History shows only the last 7 days, or the words and the journey say older lines stay; the test checks the agreed one.
fix_line: Agree what History keeps, then make the words, the screen and the test say the same

title: No test opens the Shop screen and checks what the owner or desk sees
what: None of the Shop screen's words is checked by any screen test: the empty shop, the photo toast, "Orders · 1 new", the ready and collected toasts, the cancel sheet, hide and delete, and what the desk sees. Only the shop's sums and the server's order moves are tested.
expected: A screen test walks the shop as the owner and as the desk: add a product, an order arrives, ready, collected, cancel with stock back, hide.
fix_line: Add one shop screen test for the owner and one for the desk

title: Going back to MettleUp's look, the save message and the member-app-off card are never tested
what: No test presses "Use MettleUp's look" to take a gym's logo and colours off the member app, checks the "Saved. New members see it at once…" message, or opens Branding with the member app off.
expected: A screen test saves a look, goes back to MettleUp's look with its question first, and checks the form and the header go back to plain.
fix_line: Add a Branding test for going back to the plain look and for the save message

title: The check-in poster page is never opened by a test
what: No screen test opens Check-in QR: its title, the gym-code line, print and save-as-picture, the "Could not make the picture" fallback, and the "Put your gym online first" card for a browser-only gym are all unchecked.
expected: A screen test opens the poster for an online gym and a browser-only gym and checks the words and the picture save.
fix_line: Add one test that opens the check-in poster page

title: The alerts card is never tested when alerts are blocked or on an iPhone
what: No test shows "Alerts are blocked in this browser…" or the iPhone and iPad "add to Home Screen first" words, so a turn-on button that does nothing would not be caught.
expected: A test opens the alerts card with notices blocked and as an iPhone browser and checks the words and that no dead button shows.
fix_line: Add the blocked and iPhone cases to the alerts test

title: The demo as the front desk never shows the owner-only refusals on screen
what: The desk demo test walks five desk pages but never opens Staff & sign-in or an owner-only page, so "Only an owner can add people…" and "Only an owner can see this" are never seen in the demo.
expected: The desk demo test opens an owner-only address and the staff page and checks the refusal words.
how_often: every sales demo as the desk
fix_line: Add two owner-only pages to the desk demo walk

title: Signing up with a number that already has a gym, or tapping Create twice, is never tested
what: No test tries Set up a new gym with a mobile that already owns a gym (the "Sign in instead" message), and none taps Create my gym twice to check only one gym is made. The "Setting up…" line and the gym-ready sheet's copy and QR buttons are not checked either.
expected: A sign-up test covers an existing number with no other gym name shown, and a double tap that makes one gym.
fix_line: Add the existing-number and double-tap cases to the sign-up test

title: Your numbers are never checked to change after a payment or new check-ins
what: No test takes a payment or checks members in and then looks at Fees due or Busy hours to see the figures move without a reload. The shared report is never checked to leave out member names and numbers.
expected: A test takes a payment and two timed check-ins, then checks the fees-owed figure drops and the busy hours count them; the print page shows totals only.
fix_line: Add a change-then-look step to the numbers test and a no-names check on the report
